name: MQ-9 Reaper
summary: Long-endurance remotely piloted hunter-killer aircraft used by the Air Force and Marine Corps for ISR and precision strike.

wings: Long, straight, high-aspect-ratio wing mounted mid-fuselage
Underwing pylons for Hellfire missiles, bombs or fuel tanks
engines: Single turboprop with a pusher propeller at the very rear
fuselage: No cockpit: bulbous nose housing a satellite dish
Sensor ball and radar under the nose
Fat, rounded fuselage, larger than earlier Predator-family drones
tail: Y-shaped tail: two surfaces angled upward in a V plus a single fin pointing down
Propeller sits between the tail surfaces

tellTales: Upward V-tail with a fin underneath, forming a Y
Rear pusher propeller on a windowless bulbous fuselage
Long straight wings carrying missiles or bombs

confusedWith.howToTell: The MQ-9 has an upward V-tail with a fin underneath and a fatter body; the MQ-1C has a downward-pointing inverted V-tail and a slimmer body.
The MQ-9 is a windowless drone with a rear propeller and Y-tail; the U-2 is a piloted jet with a canopy and a single fin.

usCount.source: Congressional Research Service IF13318 (Air Force testimony, May 2026)
